title: Beast Will
text: The essence of a mana beast. Hold a Beast Will core and Acquire it, then Integrate it for its full form. A will assimilates over hours of play, can be trained, and strains you if overused. Wills have ranks C, B, A, S and SS. All eight beast cores (E to SS) carry a will: Ridge-Wolf, Crested Boar, Wind-Skimmer Raptor, Flame-Serpent, Shadow Panther, Thunder-Fang Chimera, Elderwood Guardian, Nihil Dragon. Everything is in the Beast Will tab of the Multiverse menu: bars, abilities with cooldowns, Acquire, Integrate, Swap. The absorb question also opens inside that menu.
